import re

RULE = re.compile(r"^-{20,}\s*$")
BANNER = re.compile(r"ROBOCOPY\s+::\s+Robust File Copy")
JOB = re.compile(r"^\s+(?P<key>[A-Z][\w ]*?) :(?:\s+(?P<value>\S.*?))?\s*$")
DIR = re.compile(r"^\t\s*(?:(?P<class>\*?[A-Za-z]+(?: [A-Za-z]+)?)\s+)?(?P<count>-?\d+)\t(?P<path>[^\t]+?)\s*$")
FILE = re.compile(r"^\t\s*(?P<class>\*?[A-Za-z]+(?: [A-Za-z]+)?)\s*\t+\s*(?P<size>[\d.]+(?: [kmg])?)\t(?P<name>[^\t]+?)\s*$")
ERROR = re.compile(r"^(?P<time>\d{4}/\d\d/\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d) ERROR (?P<code>\d+) \((?P<hex>0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)\) (?P<action>[A-Z][\w-]*(?: [A-Z][\w-]*)*) (?P<path>\S.*?)\s*$")
RETRY = re.compile(r"^Waiting \d+ seconds\.\.\. Retrying\.\.\.\s*$")
HEADER = re.compile(r"^\s+Total\s+Copied\s+Skipped\s+Mismatch\s+FAILED\s+Extras\s*$")
ROW = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<item>[A-Za-z]+) :")


def parse(lines):
    job, dirs, files, errors, summary = [], [], [], [], []
    used = {"job": [], "dirs": [], "files": [], "errors": [], "summary": []}
    skip = []
    seen = {}
    cur_dir, err, ends = "", None, None
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            ends = None
            continue
        if RULE.match(ln) or BANNER.search(ln):
            skip.append(j)
            err = None
            continue
        if HEADER.match(ln):
            # robocopy right-aligns the summary under fixed columns: slice by the header's word ends
            ends = [(m.group(0), m.end()) for m in re.finditer(r"\S+", ln)]
            used["summary"].append(j)
            continue
        if ends is not None and ROW.match(ln):
            rec = {"Item": ROW.match(ln).group("item")}
            prev = ROW.match(ln).end()
            for name, end in ends:
                rec[name] = ln[prev:end].strip()
                prev = end
            summary.append(rec)
            used["summary"].append(j)
            continue
        m = ERROR.match(ln)
        if m:
            err = {"directory": cur_dir, "Time": m.group("time"), "Error": m.group("code"), "Code": m.group("hex"),
                   "Action": m.group("action"), "Path": m.group("path"), "message": "", "retry": ""}
            errors.append(err)
            used["errors"].append(j)
            continue
        m = FILE.match(ln)
        if m and not m.group("class").endswith("Dir"):
            # a file sits under the last directory heading
            files.append({"directory": cur_dir, "Class": m.group("class"), "Size": m.group("size"), "File": m.group("name")})
            used["files"].append(j)
            err = None
            continue
        m = DIR.match(ln)
        if m:
            cur_dir = m.group("path")
            dirs.append({"Class": m.group("class") or "", "Files": m.group("count"), "Directory": cur_dir})
            used["dirs"].append(j)
            err = None
            continue
        if err is not None:
            # the system error text and the retry notice belong to the ERROR line above
            if RETRY.match(ln):
                err["retry"] = ln.strip()
            else:
                err["message"] = (err["message"] + " " if err["message"] else "") + ln.strip()
            used["errors"].append(j)
            continue
        m = JOB.match(ln)
        if m:
            key = m.group("key")
            seen[key] = seen.get(key, 0) + 1
            if seen[key] > 1:
                key = f"{key} {seen[key]}"
            job.append({key: m.group("value") or ""})
            used["job"].append(j)
    return {"blocks": [{"name": "job", "kind": "kv", "lines": used["job"], "records": job},
                       {"name": "directories", "kind": "table", "lines": used["dirs"], "records": dirs},
                       {"name": "files", "kind": "table", "lines": used["files"], "records": files},
                       {"name": "errors", "kind": "table", "lines": used["errors"], "records": errors},
                       {"name": "summary", "kind": "table", "lines": used["summary"], "records": summary}],
            "skip": skip}
